reviews.text: I took my cats to MaisonBau for grooming and I'm thrilled with the results! Kindness, courtesy, and great professionalism are combined with great attention to detail in the service: my cats smell wonderful and are still so soft even after days! Even though they're not used to grooming, they had them bathed, brushed, and had the tangles removed that inevitably plague them with long fur, their nails trimmed, and their ears cleaned... Daniela and Francesca were fantastic; you can feel their love for animals and their extensive experience in their work! Plus, the quality/price ratio is excellent!! I recommend MaisonBau 100%!
Excellent empathy with my dogs. Trudy and Giunone thank Francesca. Well done, I recommend her 👏🏼👏🏼♥️ …
Very unserious and unfair, they have no respect for their customers.
Very good and very kind and the Maltese had a great time... thanks, see you soon.

Excellent service. Daniela is fantastic, my Linus loves her (even though he doesn't like baths in general...). He comes out smelling good and with super soft fur. I've been using them for almost two years now and I'm very happy with them. Great professionalism and extreme kindness. Complete service (bath, nail trimming, bottom trimming, ozone treatment) for only €30. What more could you ask for?
I have been bringing my poodle and my chihuahua here to Maison Bau for a year now and I always find it a good place, I recommend it!!

Every time she comes out of the bath, she smells wonderful, and the great care they put into every aspect of her grooming is always evident. Highly recommended!

It's always been a truly positive experience, a place where, in addition to the satisfaction of the service, everything is done with the ability to observe what's being done and rest assured that your dog is being treated well and safe. I've waited outside many times and observed just this. But today something happened that left me stunned.
My 14-year-old Maltese, weighing 3.5 kg and deaf, was rejected after countless visits because he was declared a biter. My dog ​​is fearful, agitated, and cries when away from me, and he's been groomed several times at this grooming salon while he's outside, always treated well and paid well. Now, a very dangerous dog like mine—ironic of course—who had an appointment, was not only denied service by professionals, but also labeled a biter. This really pisses me off; it's shattering my hunger for my dearest ones, and I'm the one who doesn't want to go there anymore. I repeat, impeccable service, but not in labeling and hurting my dog ​​with inappropriate labels. I don't allow a 14-year-old puppy who faced things no one can imagine, who was hospitalized for two months and fought like a lion for his life, to be called a biter. If that were the case, they never should have done it, and above all, I was there waiting outside many times.

Vincenzo and Fiocco thank you for better understanding things, and above all, thank you for coming back again...

I took my 3-year-old golden retriever to this grooming shop last week and was really pleased! Vanessa helped us with some questions we had during the booking process, as we'd never taken our dog to a groomer before. She was very kind and treated the dog with great care throughout the entire wash. One detail I really appreciated was the window overlooking the street: it allows you to see the entire grooming process, giving a sense of transparency.
The environment is clean, welcoming, and professional. We'll definitely be back!
